claim_tested: SIA1 acts on Pma1 glucose activation
key_finding: yor137c-delta loses the glucose-triggered Pma1 Vmax increase; Pma1 plasma-membrane level unchanged. Authors propose >=2 independent mechanisms.
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate. Genetic, indirect; no SIA1 protein assayed, no substrate, no localization. Cannot establish direct action on Pma1.

key_finding: SIA1 transcript up-regulated by short-term ethanol stress

claim_tested: Family precedent for substrate side of the membrane
key_finding: Dcr2, the closest characterised PTHR32440 relative, dephosphorylates Ire1 in vitro and binds phospho-mimetic Ire1
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate. Dcr2 acts on a cytosolic kinase domain, which is hard to reconcile with a lumenal SIA1 active site. Dcr2 is a relative, not an ortholog.

claim_tested: Positive charges at the cytosol-membrane interface block signal peptidase cleavage
key_finding: Replacing the positively charged interface residue of corin with neutral/acidic residues causes secretion, i.e. cleavage
context: Human corin, LDLR, matriptase-2 in cultured cells
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate. Mechanistically apt for SIA1's +4 n-region but demonstrated in mammalian type II proteases, not yeast.

claim_tested: Charged flanks set Nin/Cout orientation; hydrophobicity drives integration
key_finding: Positive-inside rule governs orientation of the initial signal; hydrophobicity is the main integration driver

claim_tested: Negative residues are depleted on the cytoplasmic flank and enriched outside
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate. SIA1 has 0 acidic residues in 1-28 and D29 immediately after the h-region, satisfying both rules for Nin/Cout.

claim_tested: Additional TM segments, GPI signal, HDEL, dilysine
key_finding: 0 of 604 Kyte-Doolittle 19-mer windows reach 1.6; global max 1.44 at res 9-27. C-terminal 25 aa mean KD -1.13, ends ...IYKGKQ. No HDEL/KDEL, no KKxx/KxKxx, no QRPL.
confidence_and_limitations: High for the negatives. Refutes polytopic, GPI cell wall, HDEL-retained ER-resident and vacuolar classes.

claim_tested: Cleaved SP vs signal anchor from n-region charge
key_finding: Net charge +4 in res 1-12: 99.4th pct of 335 yeast SPs (4/335) vs 95.1st pct of 235 anchors (19/235); LR 6.8 toward anchor
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate. Single feature; the anomaly is real but one feature cannot settle the call.

claim_tested: Where, if anywhere, does signal peptidase cut
key_finding: von Heijne PWM (-13..+2) trained on 343 yeast SPs: best site is res 27 (score 5.41, 32.7th pct of true sites); Phobius' res 35 scores -2.85 (0.9th pct). LR 3.45 toward cleavage.
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate-high for ranking sites. Supersedes the cruder binary (-3,-1) rule, which fails at 27 on Tyr25.

claim_tested: How much weight does the Phobius call deserve
key_finding: InterPro-precomputed Phobius: SP 1-35, mature 36-622 non-cytoplasmic, no TM. Benchmark: 17/70 (24.3%, 95% CI 14.8-36.0) true yeast N-terminal anchors wrongly called cleaved SP; 22/33 true SPs called SP. LR only 2.74.
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate. KRE2 and KTR1, the closest profile matches to SIA1, are both misclassified with the same error pattern. EBI job dispatcher blocked live SignalP/Phobius runs.

claim_tested: Is the N-terminal signal a prediction artefact
key_finding: UniRef50_Q12212 has 11 distinct members, all Saccharomyces sensu stricto. Tri-basic n-region and hydrophobic h-region invariant in 11/11; N-terminal peak is the global hydrophobicity max in 11/11; no HDEL, no GPI tail in any.
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate. Conservation argues the signal is functional, but the genus-restricted family blocks deeper fungal comparison. S. cerevisiae sits at the hydrophobicity floor of its own genus (1.44 vs 1.94).

claim_tested: Does structure discriminate SP from anchor
key_finding: AF-Q12212-F1: res 5-28 one continuous helix (92% i,i+4 helical), mean pLDDT 74.9, protruding mean 33 A from the catalytic domain; PF00149 domain res ~300-622 at pLDDT 89.8 with DxH317, GD355, GHEH549
confidence_and_limitations: Low for discrimination. A free protruding helix is what AlphaFold produces for both SPs and TM helices.

key_finding: SGD returns 0 protein-experiment records; CC annotation is root GO:0005575, MF root GO:0003674. SGD description states 'contains peptide signal for membrane localization', a sequence-derived claim. UniProt protein existence = level 2 (transcript level); no proteomics cross-references.
confidence_and_limitations: High confidence in the absence itself. SIA1 protein has never been detected or localized experimentally.

claim_tested: Does loss of SIA1 perturb endomembranes
key_finding: sia1-delta scored as abnormal vacuolar morphology in a systematic screen
confidence_and_limitations: Low. Single systematic screen hit, not followed up; consistent with but not evidence for secretory-pathway residence.
